sqlGroup.update: update sys_user set openid = #{openId} where mobile = #{mobile} and orgId = #{orgId}
sqlGroup.select: select COUNT(1) as cnt from sys_user a

select id from sys_user where ${key} = #{val}
and id != #{id}
sqlGroup.update: update sys_user set failCnt = ifnull(failCnt,0) + 1, status=(case when failCnt+1 >=3 then '0' else status end) where username = #{userName}
update sys_user set failCnt = 0 where username = #{userName}
update sys_user set status = '0' where acctType != '999' and date_add(updatePwdTime , interval 3 MONTH) < now()
